verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Hightouch serves an llms.txt at hightouch.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it. Hightouch also has agent-facing documentation, including official MCP server docs and guidance on scoping API keys for AI tools. The visible llms.txt excerpt reads as a marketing overview rather than a docs index, and other machine-readable formats probed (docs.md and OpenAPI paths) return 404. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt indexes the technical docs, markdown versions of doc pages, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
